Against the claim, the laptop itself is not visibly skewed or misaligned with the tabletop edges." However, the visible rear/logo side faces the open work area with the cutting mat, while the keyboard/display working side appears to point away toward the wall/material board. The laptop is on a sturdy craft worktable with relevant studio props, but its usable screen/keyboard side appears directed toward the wall/back of the table while the visible work area is at the foreground cutting mat. neighboring_furniture: No adjacent furniture or seating is visible. The perforated wall panel is behind the desk, and the small cube prop sits to the left of the laptop.

alternative_user_positions: No alternate seats are visible; the only supported user position is from the front edge facing the keyboard.
prop_relationships: The cube prop is separated from the laptop and placed near the left rear area, functioning as a harmless desk object rather than an obstruction.
lived_in_evidence: The scene is tidy and somewhat staged, but it still reads as a usable desk setup rather than disconnected props.
